description: Fork of exp274 (dual-stream E=64, residual_lut multi-alt NAP=8 tph=256 -> 1.6857). Single change: d_v 32 -> 24. Shrinks v_lut n_outputs 32->24 (~19M params off) and out_proj input dim 192->144 (no stored-param change since LUT entries depend on NAP not input_dim, but slightly leaner anchor-pair sampling). Tests whether V's per-head capacity was over-provisioned for the new dual-stream design. Comparator: exp274=1.6857 (same recipe at d_v=32).
